verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const j="app/(main)/partners/join/actions.ts",l="app/(main)/partners/listing/actions.ts";if(!fs.existsSync(j)||!fs.existsSync(l)){console.error("SCAN-761: partners action files missing");process.exit(79)}const js=fs.readFileSync(j,"utf8"),ls=fs.readFileSync(l,"utf8");const releaseHides=/from\([\x22\x27]partners[\x22\x27]\)/.test(js);const ownerUnpublish=/unpublishListing|status:\s*[\x22\x27](hidden|inactive|archived|unpublished)[\x22\x27]/.test(ls);if(!releaseHides&&!ownerUnpublish){console.error("SCAN-761: releasing a Business or Organization persona never touches the partners table, and no owner path can set a partner listing to anything but active, so a released program stays live in the directory with no way to take it down.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: Releasing the last Business or Organization persona hides the partner listing and its offers; owners also get an unpublishListing action.
